cards.title: Toddlers deserve respect for their unique culture
cards.body: Small children have their own culture that adults should respect, not dismiss or join in with uninvited. Parents who understand this avoid frustrating their toddlers and build stronger relationships.

cards.title: Don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for kids
cards.body: Rockstar's latest game is rated 18 and stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence. It's the most graphic game available and absolutely not appropriate for children.

cards.title: Three family dynamics that worsen mental health
cards.body: Decades of research show ordinary family interactions can shape depression and psychosis in children. Understanding these patterns helps parents create healthier home environments.

cards.title: How to handle when adult children pull away
cards.body: Adult children distancing themselves causes real pain for parents. Practical strategies can help manage this empty feeling and rebuild connection.

cards.title: Preparing children for an AI-powered future
cards.body: Artificial intelligence is reshaping society and children need preparation for this new reality. Parents can help by understanding AI's potential benefits and risks.

cards.title: Body shame daughters inherit from mothers
cards.body: Girls learn their body image from watching the women they love most. Breaking cycles of negative self-talk helps daughters develop healthier relationships with themselves.

cards.title: Generational differences at holiday family gatherings
cards.body: Different generations bring conflicting expectations to family holidays, creating friction. Learning to navigate these differences helps create meaningful traditions everyone enjoys.
